description: Drafts an llms.txt file (llmstxt.org convention) for the root of a domain: a structured summary of the site for language models and agents, derived from the page's real content. Returns the file text. Note: llms.txt is an emerging convention with unproven impact.

url.description: Domain or URL of the site, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com". Use your own site or one you are authorized to review.

name: generate_llms_txt
title: Generate llms.txt
